plainGateText: Expected maintenance outage: about 50 minutes, based on the listed earlier measurements and explicit allowances. The release controller can run for at most 90 minutes, with the existing individual operation deadlines and a 10-minute candidate readiness deadline. If an abort occurs after any APPLY starts, the site remains at503 until a separately reviewed forward fix; reopening within90 minutes is not promised. Before any APPLY, only a proven unchanged DB/WAL/SHM raw backup permits the retained predecessor to restart without restoring data.
